_comment: THE SOUND MAP (yours to edit!). Each entry: a game-moment id → the file that plays there. One sound means ONE thing (the designer's rule, 2026-08-25): the store bell is only the merchant, the level-up ding is only 'enough XP earned'. Spells play by ELEMENT CLASS: spells.json fx.sound picks spell_fire / spell_frost / spell_lightning / spell_light / spell_arcane; heals and buffs use spell_heal / spell_buff automatically. To change a sound: drop the file in assets/sfx/ and point the id at it. To SILENCE a moment: delete its line — a missing id plays NOTHING, never a wrong sound. MOMENT IDS THE ENGINE ALREADY CALLS but that are SILENT until you add a line here: battle_victory (the fight is won — the big missing one!), battle_start, gear_equip, hero_falls, crit_strike. Three more borrow a related file as a placeholder — replace when you have the real thing: potion_drink and temple_revive (heal-spell), trap_springs (melee strike).
